########################################################################
# Include python install macros
########################################################################
include(GrPython)
if(NOT PYTHONINTERP_FOUND)
    return()
endif()

add_subdirectory(bindings)

########################################################################
# Install python sources
########################################################################
gr_python_install(FILES __init__.py
                         _phy.py
                         radio_select.py
                         open_modem_tx.py
                         open_modem_rx.py
                         ptt_control.py
                         pdu_to_stream.py
                         ack_responder.py
                   DESTINATION ${GR_PYTHON_DIR}/gnuradio/open_modem)

########################################################################
# Handle the unit tests
########################################################################
include(GrTest)

set(GR_TEST_TARGET_DEPS gnuradio-open_modem)

# Create a package directory that tests can import. It includes everything
# from `python/`.
add_custom_target(
    copy_module_for_tests ALL
    COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND} -E copy_directory ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}
            ${PROJECT_BINARY_DIR}/test_modules/gnuradio/open_modem/)
GR_ADD_TEST(qa_open_modem_tx ${PYTHON_EXECUTABLE} ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/qa_open_modem_tx.py)
GR_ADD_TEST(qa_open_modem_rx ${PYTHON_EXECUTABLE} ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/qa_open_modem_rx.py)
GR_ADD_TEST(qa_ptt_control ${PYTHON_EXECUTABLE} ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/qa_ptt_control.py)
GR_ADD_TEST(qa_radio_select ${PYTHON_EXECUTABLE} ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/qa_radio_select.py)
GR_ADD_TEST(qa_pdu_to_stream ${PYTHON_EXECUTABLE} ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/qa_pdu_to_stream.py)
GR_ADD_TEST(qa_ack_responder ${PYTHON_EXECUTABLE} ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/qa_ack_responder.py)
